description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Gorgeous, Upscale Interior and Luxurious Furnishings* Incredible Balcony and Screened Porch* 4 Fun Pug Bikes Included* Parking for 3 Vehicles + Gas Grill* Resort-Style Amenities: Two pools, including an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf* Beach Access at Dune Allen Beach - Short Drive Away * Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertainment at Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place.* Professional Management: Rest assured with 24/7 service for a seamless experience.*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * **Nearby construction is currently taking place, and some daytime noise may be heard between 7:30 AM and 5:30 PM. We appreciate your understanding!**Welcome to Mimi's Pearl, a spacious and inviting 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom retreat designed for the perfect family vacation. Relax on your private porches, sip a refreshing drink, and take in the beautiful views from the comfort of your home. The main floor features an open-concept layout with high vaulted ceilings, seamlessly connecting the living room, dining area, and professional-grade kitchen—perfect for gathering and creating home-cooked meals together.This thoughtfully designed home offers a variety of comfortable sleeping arrangements. On the first floor, you’ll find a queen guest bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, along with a convenient half bath. Upstairs, the master suite boasts a luxurious king bed and private ensuite, while another guest room features two queen beds with its own bathroom. A fun and cozy bunk room includes both a twin/twin and a twin/full bunk, ideal for younger guests. Enjoy access to fantastic community amenities, including a sparkling pool, tennis courts, and scenic nature trails. Make Mimi’s Pearl your go-to vacation getaway for years to come!Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!**NO SMOKING at this property. There should be no smoking within 100 yards of this home, per neighborhood rules.***Wristbands need to be worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband. *The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Queen BedsGuest Bedroom 3: Twin Bunkbed + Twin-over-Full BunkbedArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
